<thought>The most intense peak at m/z 134.10955 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈133.102 Da. The M+1 intensity (~11 % of M) suggests about ten carbon atoms (≈10 × 1.1 % ≈ 11 %). A formula with ten carbons and a mass matching 133.102 Da is C₁₀H₁₃ (10 × 12.0000 + 13 × 1.007825 = 133.1017 Da), which fits the observed isotope pattern (M+2 ≈ 0.5 % from two ¹³C atoms). No oxygen or other heteroatoms are required.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H13</final_answer>
